recommendation: Snapshot-to-artifact durable CLI job first, thin local stdio MCP second. Outer agent reviews, verifies in isolation and applies accepted changes.
first_slice: One small real Python patch from an explicitly selected snapshot, pinned recipe, bounded budget; return normalized files/diff, check evidence and full trace. Analysis-only mode is optional and should not delay this.
gpu_policy: Reuse canonical gpu-experiment.lock; fail fast busy; never attach to another experiment endpoint or silently switch it. Session service gating remains outside jobs.
reuse: existing GPU lock and session restoration
missing: general public snapshot adapter separate from named benchmark task admission
normalized candidate export with allowed-path and stale-base checks
success_measure: Useful accepted work and rough-edge discoveries, with outer packaging/review/repair effort and total cold/warm time recorded. Do not equate green public tests with independent acceptance.
followup_scope: Design requested within current goal; implementation is proposed subsequent work. Avoid building all optional queue/service/analysis-mode features before first useful patch.
